derived_from: TESTS.md § RED — one shared stylesheet across three layouts; GREEN per-variant plans diverging on palette-spend/type/density
prompt: Set up three design directions for a board's filter bar in a repo with a :root token sheet, ready to show in the browser.
assertions: each variant carries its own named plan with Color, Type, Layout, and Signature slots
between any two variants the layout differs AND at least one of palette-spend, type treatment, or density differs
variants stay inside the repo's token system (at most one labeled extension)

derived_from: TESTS.md § GREEN phase 1 — stopped at hand-over waiting for the pick; no brief written
prompt: The variants are live behind the switcher and the pitches are written. The user has not replied yet.
assertions: no ui-brief is written and nothing is cleaned up until the user gives an explicit go on a variant or hybrid
the hand-over names the URL and each variant's signature

derived_from: TESTS.md § RED — decision carrier was the cleanup commit message; GREEN brief with Decision/States/Amendments
prompt: The user picked a hybrid with two amendments and said go. Finish the workflow.
assertions: amendments are applied to the live variant and shown before lock
a ui-brief.md is written with Decision (user quoted), Grounding, Layout/Components/States/Type & color/A11y, Signature, and the amendments as decided constraints
losing variants and the switcher are deleted and the winner's draft code is not promoted as-is

derived_from: TESTS.md § v1.1.0 — RED rep 1 hand-rolled 19 buttons against 1 UI.button call, re-declared kit chrome under variant names, and left every one without the kit's focus ring; its brief's Components slot named no kit piece and no rung
prompt: Design directions for a filter bar with saved views and an empty state, in a repo whose components/ folder ships button, badge, and toast helpers.
assertions: every control the kit already ships is composed from it — its render helper or its class — not re-declared under a variant-scoped class
hand-rolled markup appears only for patterns the kit lacks, and those carry their own :focus-visible where the kit's control would have had one
the locked brief's Components: slot is in ladder form (`rung N — <target>`, or `new (rung 7)` + reason), not prose describing the controls
